outperformer.headline: Superior capital efficiency and profitability driven by operational leverage and volume-led growth
outperformer.reason: J K Cements delivers a 15.1% ROCE versus the peer median of 9.78% and a 15.6% ROE against 7.83%, marking it as the clear capital efficiency leader in the Indian cement sector. Its 83% gross margin sits well above the 77.7% median, while maintaining a 17% EBITDA margin in line with peers. The company's outperformance stems from operational efficiencies that have recently kicked in, benefiting more from volume growth than pricing power. With a 33.4% profit CAGR over three years (versus 20.2% median) and consistent 15% average ROE over both 3-year and 5-year periods, J K Cements demonstrates sustained execution quality. Its relatively moderate 0.88 debt-to-equity ratio provides financial flexibility while the business scales, and the 15.7% revenue CAGR over five years confirms strong top-line momentum that translates directly to bottom-line performance through improved operating leverage.
outperformer.india_vs_global: J K Cements' 15.1% ROCE and 15.6% ROE place it among the top-quartile performers globally in cement, where capital intensity typically constrains returns; its operational efficiency gains mirror best-in-class regional players while maintaining India's structural growth tailwinds.

ranking.reason: Best-in-class capital efficiency with 15.1% ROCE and 15.6% ROE, both significantly above peer medians. Strong operational leverage driving 33.4% profit CAGR while maintaining disciplined balance sheet with 0.88 debt-to-equity.

Highest EBITDA margin at 25% and strong 16.6% ROCE driven by efficient logistics network navigating difficult topography. Excellent profitability with 10.3% PAT margin versus 7.2% median, though smaller scale limits absolute impact.

Market leader with massive scale advantage and solid 12.7% ROCE, 11.1% ROE above medians. Strong 19% EBITDA margin and 9.1x interest coverage demonstrate operational strength, though growth moderating from peak levels.

Strong 21% EBITDA margin and excellent working capital management with -55 days. However, 6.11% ROE and 7.59% ROCE trail peers, with near-flat profit growth (2.4% 3Y CAGR) indicating operational challenges despite margin strength.

Exceptional 86.8% gross margin and 22% EBITDA margin with minimal debt (0.08 D/E). However, 7.51% ROE lags median and -5.2% profit CAGR over 5 years shows declining profitability despite margin leadership. High inventory days (469) raise efficiency concerns.

Highest PAT margin at 13.9% and virtually debt-free (0.01 D/E) with 29.4x interest coverage. Strong 23.1% profit CAGR, but 5.61% ROCE significantly trails peers, indicating capital deployment challenges despite profitability.

Solid 12% ROCE and 10.7% ROE above medians with exceptional cash conversion (108.2% CFO/Op) and best-in-class 6 debtor days. However, flat profit growth (3.8% 3Y CAGR) and smaller scale limit upside potential.
Strong 34.2% profit CAGR and 11.2% ROCE with minimal debt. However, negative CFO (-46.1% CFO/Op) and 11% EBITDA margin (lowest among major players) indicate operational stress despite profit growth.

Largest revenue base with strong 21% EBITDA margin, but diversified conglomerate structure dilutes cement focus. Poor 4.98% ROE, negative CFO (-49.1% CFO/Op), and high 2.2 debt-to-equity raise concerns about capital allocation and cash generation.

Matches peer median ROCE (9.78%) and ROE (7.83%) with impressive 140.7% profit CAGR from low base. However, 5.8% PAT margin trails median and -2.4% profit CAGR over 5 years shows cyclical volatility rather than sustained improvement.

Efficient working capital at -98 days and solid cash conversion. However, weak 4.17% ROE, 6.99% ROCE, and 3.2% PAT margin all trail medians significantly. Despite 182.3% profit CAGR, absolute profitability remains subdued.

Excellent cash conversion (112.1% CFO/Op) and working capital efficiency. However, 0.38% ROE is critically weak, 6.13% ROCE trails badly, and -2.3% profit CAGR over 5 years shows deteriorating fundamentals despite operational efficiency.

Solid 19% EBITDA margin and 11.1% ROCE with efficient working capital. However, -12.3% PAT margin and ₹799 Cr net loss indicate the business is unprofitable at the bottom line despite operational improvements, limiting investment appeal.

Minimal profitability with 0.4% PAT margin and negative -5.41% ROE. Despite positive cash flow, 9% EBITDA margin is lowest in peer set and -26.5% profit CAGR over 5 years shows sustained value destruction.

Unprofitable with -1.5% PAT margin and ₹67 Cr net loss. Critically weak 0.37% ROE and 1.24% ROCE with -7.2% revenue CAGR over 3 years indicate fundamental business deterioration. Low debt provides limited cushion but no growth catalyst.
